verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel in evidence is EFILE/ReFILE. It is restricted to certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers, who transmit returns and amended T1s system-to-system. The rest of the online services are documented only as portal/UI flows: BN registration in BRO, submitting documents, payments, direct deposit, enquiries, responding to notices and authorizing representatives. So there is a narrow filing API, nowhere near UI parity. Missing for 10: any general-purpose public API, API coverage of registration, payments, documents, notices and account management, open developer access without certification, and independent confirmation of API scope.
